citations.claim: first in_arena violation: body extends beyond arena limit
few steps before still inside arena approaching boundary at high horizontal speed

counterfactual.change: Reduced initial vx from 13.718 to 5.0 m/s, lowering horizontal displacement so body remains inside arena for all 140 steps; same dt/gravity/steps.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has single body launched horizontally at 13.7 m/s with gravity 9.81 and dt~0.00735, no walls. Semi-implicit Euler with 5 substeps cannot stop body at arena boundary (20,12). At step 138 body still inside (overshoot -0.04), but by step 140 x=19.329 with r=0.83 gives overshoot 0.159 >0.15 limit, velocity unchanged (no collision response with boundary wall). Cause: boundary walls are not enforced as collisions when wall list empty / tunneling through boundary not prevented vs integration overshoot - body exits arena without bounce.
vision_note: The red circle travels steadily to the right and reaches the black arena border around step 138-139, then protrudes outside the arena in step 140 instead of stopping or bouncing. No wall or collision response is visible as the body half-exits the frame at the bottom-right edge.
